description: Instruction following and output format, checked deterministically: exact JSON, exact text, regular expressions, line counts.

messages.content: Return a JSON object with exactly two keys: "name" set to the string Ada Lovelace and "born" set to the number 1815. Output only the JSON, with no code fence and no other text.

Extract the city and the temperature from this sentence as a JSON object with the keys "city" (a string) and "temperature_c" (an integer): "At noon the thermometer in Reykjavik read 7 degrees Celsius." Output only the JSON object, with no code fence.
Sort these numbers in ascending order and output them as a JSON array of numbers, with nothing else: 42, 7, 19, 3, 88, 19
What colour is a clear daytime sky? Answer with exactly one lowercase word and no punctuation.
A project is at version 2.3.7. Under semantic versioning, what is the version number of its next minor release? Reply with the version number only, without a v prefix.
List the three primary colours of light, one per line, in lowercase, with no numbering, bullets or other text.

Convert this list to CSV with the header line name,qty and then one line per item, in the same order. Output only the CSV, with no code fence.
apples: 3
pears: 12
plums: 0
Repeat the following text exactly, but in uppercase, and output nothing else: local agent stack, version 1

title: Anthropic route: exact JSON with an array

messages.content: Return a JSON object with the key "host" set to "nas", the key "port" set to the number 22 and the key "tags" set to an array with the strings "zfs" and "backup", in that order. Output only the JSON, with no code fence.

Create a JSON object for a to-do item with exactly these fields: "id" (an integer greater than 0), "title" (a non-empty string), "done" (the boolean false) and "tags" (an array of at least two lowercase strings). Output only the JSON object, with no code fence.

title: image input: read back the text in a bundled PNG (optional until verified on the server)

content.text: The image shows one line of text: a word and a number in capital letters. Reply with exactly that text and nothing else: no quotes, no punctuation, no explanation.
